Proxy breadth and short-lookback rotation context are constructive, while longer-lookback rotation readings, relative ETH weakness, divergent ETF flows, and mixed microstructure prevent confirmation of broad altcoin transmission or a stable cycle phase. Prior W39 range scoring was strong, but no deterministic-baseline score is available and no automatic range-method or model promotion is warranted. No new forecast candidate is emitted because the supplied calibration record does not provide a governed prospective target window for a new candidate.
